name: shinchantw_cbt_first_day_boss_fail_return_d1_retention_20260730_210404_520565
sql:
/*
===============================================================================
目的：比较 2026-07-29 首日「Boss 失败后被送回同小节第 1 关、且当天未再打到 Boss」
      的玩家，与小节内第 1~4 关没有重复挑战的玩家，其次日登录留存。

主线关卡 stage_name_real 格式：章节-小节-关卡；每小节第 5 关为 Boss。
Boss 失败代理（README 已定义）：同一账号、同一小节的第 1 关第 2 次出现。
这不是服务端真实胜负字段。
===============================================================================
*/
WITH UserBlacklist AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" AS user_id
    FROM user_result_cluster_18
    WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users', 'is_windows', 'is_water')
),
CohortUsers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT v."#account_id" AS account_id
    FROM ta.v_event_18 v
    LEFT JOIN UserBlacklist b ON v."#user_id" = b.user_id
    WHERE v."$part_event" = 'new_role'
      AND v."$part_date" = '2026-07-29'
      AND v."#account_id" IS NOT NULL
      AND b.user_id IS NULL
),
StageMap AS (
    SELECT
        TRY_CAST("stage_id@stage_id" AS BIGINT) AS stage_id,
        MAX("stage_id@stage_name_real") AS stage_name_real
    FROM ta_dim.dim_18_0_52765
    GROUP BY 1
),
ParsedStageEvents AS (
    SELECT
        v."#account_id" AS account_id,
        v."#event_time" AS event_time,
        TRY_CAST(v.role_lev AS INTEGER) AS role_level,
        CONCAT(SPLIT(m.stage_name_real, '-')[1], '-', SPLIT(m.stage_name_real, '-')[2]) AS section_key,
        TRY_CAST(SPLIT(m.stage_name_real, '-')[3] AS INTEGER) AS stage_no
    FROM ta.v_event_18 v
    INNER JOIN CohortUsers c ON v."#account_id" = c.account_id
    LEFT JOIN UserBlacklist b ON v."#user_id" = b.user_id
    INNER JOIN StageMap m
      ON m.stage_id = COALESCE(TRY_CAST(v.a_rst[1].id AS BIGINT), TRY_CAST(v.stage_id AS BIGINT))
    WHERE v."#event_name" = 'stage_fight'
      AND TRY_CAST(v.a_rst[1].key AS INTEGER) = 1001
      AND v."$part_date" = '2026-07-29'
      AND b.user_id IS NULL
      AND CARDINALITY(SPLIT(m.stage_name_real, '-')) = 3
      AND TRY_CAST(SPLIT(m.stage_name_real, '-')[3] AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1 AND 5
),
OrderedSectionEvents AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(CASE WHEN stage_no = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (
            PARTITION BY account_id, section_key
            ORDER BY event_time
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS first_stage_seen
    FROM ParsedStageEvents
),
BossFailSections AS (
    SELECT account_id, section_key, MIN(event_time) AS boss_fail_return_time
    FROM OrderedSectionEvents
    WHERE stage_no = 1
      AND first_stage_seen = 2
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),
FailedAndNoBossRetry AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT f.account_id
    FROM BossFailSections f
    LEFT JOIN ParsedStageEvents e
      ON e.account_id = f.account_id
     AND e.section_key = f.section_key
     AND e.stage_no = 5
     AND e.event_time > f.boss_fail_return_time
    WHERE e.account_id IS NULL
),
SectionStageCounts AS (
    SELECT account_id, section_key, stage_no, COUNT(*) AS attempts
    FROM ParsedStageEvents
    WHERE stage_no BETWEEN 1 AND 4
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
),
NoRepeatControlCandidates AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT account_id
    FROM (
        SELECT account_id, section_key
        FROM SectionStageCounts
        GROUP BY 1, 2
        HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT stage_no) = 4
           AND MAX(attempts) = 1
    ) eligible_sections
),
EligibleUsers AS (
    SELECT account_id, 'Boss失败后未再到同节Boss（推断受阻）' AS player_group
    FROM FailedAndNoBossRetry

    UNION ALL

    SELECT c.account_id, '同节1~4关均无重复挑战（对照）' AS player_group
    FROM NoRepeatControlCandidates c
    LEFT JOIN FailedAndNoBossRetry f ON c.account_id = f.account_id
    WHERE f.account_id IS NULL
),
UserLevels AS (
    SELECT account_id, MAX(role_level) AS max_role_level
    FROM ParsedStageEvents
    GROUP BY 1
),
LevelledEligibleUsers AS (
    SELECT
        e.account_id,
        e.player_group,
        CASE
            WHEN u.max_role_level IS NULL THEN '未知等级'
            ELSE CONCAT(
                CAST(10 * FLOOR((u.max_role_level - 1) / 10) + 1 AS VARCHAR),
                '-',
                CAST(10 * FLOOR((u.max_role_level - 1) / 10) + 10 AS VARCHAR)
            )
        END AS "首日最高等级段"
    FROM EligibleUsers e
    LEFT JOIN UserLevels u ON e.account_id = u.account_id
),
NextDayLogin AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT v."#account_id" AS account_id
    FROM ta.v_event_18 v
    LEFT JOIN UserBlacklist b ON v."#user_id" = b.user_id
    WHERE v."$part_event" = 'login'
      AND v."$part_date" = CAST(DATE_ADD('day', 1, DATE '2026-07-29') AS VARCHAR)
      AND b.user_id IS NULL
)
SELECT
    e."首日最高等级段",
    e.player_group AS "玩家分组",
    COUNT(DISTINCT e.account_id) AS "玩家数",
    COUNT(DISTINCT l.account_id) AS "D1登录人数",
    ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT l.account_id) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT e.account_id), 0), 2) AS "D1留存率(%)"
FROM LevelledEligibleUsers e
LEFT JOIN NextDayLogin l ON e.account_id = l.account_id
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY
    CASE WHEN e."首日最高等级段" = '未知等级' THEN 99999
         ELSE TRY_CAST(SPLIT(e."首日最高等级段", '-')[1] AS INTEGER) END,
    2;
